title: No bare ground: something stands within a few metres of most points near the player
note: Bare ground between the buildings is what makes a place read as a stage set: something stands within 3 m of most points near the player.
intent: A place with three good buildings and nothing between them reads as a stage set the moment the player walks off the path. Fill the ground the way a real settlement does: fences and low walls along the edges, woodpiles and barrels and crates against the walls, a cart, tool leaning, a trough, grass tufts and stones scattered with a seeded rng, ruts where people walk. Instance the repeated pieces so the draw-call budget survives, and place them by rule (against a wall, beside a door, along a fence line) rather than uniformly at random, so the clutter reads as used rather than sprinkled.

check.js: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome|water-plane/i; const all = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)); const pts = all.map(o => o.getWorldPosition(o.position.clone())); const px = player?.x ?? state?.player?.x ?? 0, pz = player?.z ?? state?.player?.z ?? 0; let hit = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const a = i * 2.399963, r = 4 + 21 * ((i * 0.618034) % 1); const x = px + Math.cos(a) * r, z = pz + Math.sin(a) * r; if (pts.some(p => (p.x - x) * (p.x - x) + (p.z - z) * (p.z - z) <= 9)) hit++; } return hit / 60 >= 0.6; })()
check.detail: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome|water-plane/i; const all = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)); const pts = all.map(o => o.getWorldPosition(o.position.clone())); const px = player?.x ?? 0, pz = player?.z ?? 0; let hit = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const a = i * 2.399963, r = 4 + 21 * ((i * 0.618034) % 1); const x = px + Math.cos(a) * r, z = pz + Math.sin(a) * r; if (pts.some(p => (p.x - x) * (p.x - x) + (p.z - z) * (p.z - z) <= 9)) hit++; } return 'sample points within 25 m of the player that have a tagged object within 3 m: ' + hit + '/60 (need 36)'; })()
check.note: Extent: of 60 points sampled in a 25 m disc around the player, at least 60% have some tagged object (not terrain/sky/fog/lights) within 3 m. Bare ground between the buildings is what makes a village read as a stage set.

port: The facet that owns the world adds a dressing pass after the buildings exist, driven by the same seeded rng, and tags everything it scatters.
